name: perps-platform
description: Multi-venue perps trading platform (Hyperliquid + Lighter + Ostium). Forked from the Hyperliquid builder-codes repo; HL is the first venue adapter.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @alchemy-hl/shared && npm run build -w @alchemy-hl/venues && npm run build -w @alchemy-hl/sdk-preview && npm run build -w @alchemy-hl/sdk && npm run build -w @alchemy-hl/api && npm run build -w @alchemy-hl/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @alchemy-hl/venues && npm run test -w @alchemy-hl/api && npm run test -w @alchemy-hl/sdk && npm run test -w @alchemy-hl/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b apps/api apps/web packages/shared packages/venues packages/sdk-preview --pretty
